# A record whose Chinese ends in {7f} is followed by the next one in the same talk: the split between them may move. \n breaks a row.

column2: text
Welcome! Care to buy something to eat?
Come, young one! Buy weapons! Mine are the best!
Welcome, welcome! Buy some armor to protect yourself!
Welcome! Need healing, or a cure for poison?
Welcome! Welcome! Would you like to stay the night?
Hello! I buy used goods. Anything to sell me?
Thank you!
Enter a number?
Sorry! That number is not right!
Too much! You can't carry any more!
Maiyin Corridor
This month has been terrible: the earth shook, thunder and rain without end. They say beastmen from Mount Wuta were seen in town, and someone was even attacked.

Legend says the sun god Saiou loves to ride the wind to the far north, and each time he decks his wind chariot with ten thousand purple-heart flowers. That is why the purple lights of the north are called the "purple solar wind".
Sangdesi, don't wander out of the village. If you must go, take a weapon to defend yourself. They say many beastmen have gathered outside the village, and they hurt people.
I hear the legendary mage-priests all have undying souls, so even when they die they can come back to life.
Sangdesi, your father is truly great! If King Maiya had not called on him, no one would have known he was a knight of the Wall Knights, the strongest order in the world!
Sangdesi, your father must have left some fine weapons at home. Why not go home and look?
Legend tells of a book called the Heaven's Notes, full of prophecies. They say whoever gets it gains tremendous power.
Huh! What are you carrying that worn-out badge for? It won't keep the beastmen off.
Your father is the Wall Knight who saved the Bangpei Empire! Our king asked him to search for the lost Princess Daini. Didn't you know?
Some say that in the siege of the Bangpei Empire twenty years ago, King Sigao and Queen Ailun fought on, twenty against a hundred thousand, and then were luckily carried off by a thick fog.
Your father left in a hurry. He asked me to tell you he left some things in the cellar at home. I think you'd better go and look.
I hear that past the Maiyin Corridor, if you keep going north, you will find Mount Qichong.

Don't go near the beastmen outside the village; they're terrifying! Some look like crabs, some have three heads, and there are green monsters sticky all over. You can drive them off with exorcism shots.
The old folks say the Demonstar Charm can call up the seven great mages who died. Use four Demonstar Charms, and Nadi, the most terrible of them, the Archmage, will rise again.
Uncle Siteli is telling stories at his house again. Want to listen? He lives in the second house from the village gate.
I don't know what's got into Uncle Siteli; he keeps telling the same story. I've no wish to hear it again.
All quiet in the village lately.
In a moment I'm going east of the village to pick tata fruit for Uncle Siteli. Want to come?!
I hear Dazhou went through many hardships before he found the entrance to the underworld.
You will surely succeed!
They say Mount Qichong has a seven-colored bird that got wisdom and magic from Mount Mata, so many people want to try their luck at Mount Mata. Sigh... without strength you can't take a single step.
Dazhou was swallowed by a fire dragon on his way to Wugeer, the underground kingdom. Sigh! The entrance to the underworld is a mystery again.
So glad to see you!
If you want to hear a story, you should know the rules here!
Come in!

Long ago on the planet Hongqi, the lands were joined as one, the seas flowed around them, and its civilization was the finest in the Great Red Galaxy. But in the year 1682 of the Ya Era, a strange thing happened in the Bangpei Empire: at the
first-birthday feast of the young prince Hudu, a horn grew from his forehead before hundreds of guests. To hide the rumor that the queen might have lain with a beastman, the once-kind King Kaluoan I
had every guest in the hall put to death. Afterwards Nadi, the Archmage who served the king, led the ten strongest mages and the beastmen of Mount Wuta and, in the name of

vengeance, marched against the king. On the fifth day the king and queen took their own lives together, but that did not stop Nadi; her cruelty only grew. Not content with slaughtering people, she used sorcery and
super-science to overturn the world. In the end Nadi was sealed away by five godlike warriors. The tale of the horn was told and retold until it became an unsolved mystery.
A painting signed Sangdesi. A line beside it reads: "Painted by Sangdesi, age nine."
Sangdesi: If you are reading this letter, something must have happened. Whatever happens, listen to your father: put your own safety first in everything, and never go
wandering about looking for me. There are fifty gold coins in the chest; use them to buy food until I return. Finally, I must tell you that I am really a Wall Knight. The Wall Knights were the
strongest guard of the Bangpei Empire's last king, every one a brave warrior. So trust me: before long I will settle this and come home safely.\n                       - Your father, Sangruike
Sangdesi: If you are reading this letter again, I must have met something I could not overcome. Perhaps I have met misfortune, or I am trapped and cannot get away, but.....
there are things I must tell you. First: I am not your real father. Forgive me, I cannot tell you yet who your father is, for that would put your life in danger.
Second: you must have heard the legend of the Warriors of the Five Directions. Yes, it is true. The chest holds the badge the Earth Warrior wore. I hope it helps you understand the
source of their power. Third: if I meet misfortune, or if you are willing to help me, first make yourself strong. Take the Demon-Seal Sword to Mount Yabolasi and find my comrade, Mr. Jianuo.
He will help you.\n                          Be safe!\n                                   Father
Proclamation of King Maiya: Whoever rescues the princess shall receive the treasures of the realm, the "Sword of Maiya" and the "Silverheart Sword".\n                   King Maiya, Eding III
Forbidden in this city: (1) carrying or selling weapons; (2) cheating or stealing from others; (3) harming others; (4) dealings with the demon world.
Extra, extra! A crazy show at the Crazy Club! Liyinka Empire Crazy Club tickets: today only 15 gold coins each!
In the east, underground, a dragon; in the west, in the sky, an ox; on the southern island, money galore; in the northern cave, a stone. What this poem means, I hope you can solve.
I just got back from Liyinka, south of the Maiyin Strait. It's simply... well, you'll only know when you go and see for yourself!
Did you know a magical seven-colored bird lives on Mount Qichong in the north? They say the mountain has seven levels, and on each lives a strange bird of a special color.
In Liezhidun someone rescued an old man from the sea. He says he lives on an island in the underground sea. That island... he called it Yisite or something. Amazing!
In the yellow sands of the south it is hot and dry all year, so indoor pastimes thrive. The frozen north tests one's endurance; hermits love to go there to train body and mind.
They say in the frozen north there is a wise old man who has locked himself in an ice cave. Who knows what it takes to open the cave's door.
Dazhou's companions say that if you could find the legendary Phantom Shield, dealing with Wugeer's fire dragon would not be so hard.
If you see Old Zhou's eldest son Dazhou, tell him to come home soon.
They say humans once could use magic too, but the turmoil of the Wuta upheaval made them forget how. Legend says that whoever is awakened by the Gate of Magic can cast spells again.
Some say the Gate of Magic was lost in the Maiyin Corridor. I wonder if it can be found there.
The hermits of Mount Yabolasi are all historians or experts. If you could get to know them, you would surely learn a great deal.
The Wall Knight who set out the day before yesterday to find the princess was Sangruike, a farmer from Sangya Village! The Maiya Empire is full of hidden talent.

Thirty years ago a man also came from the underworld. He said the red-shift death point of the Five-Ring stars is the entrance to the sea beneath the sea. What red shift? What sea beneath the sea? So strange!
I hear your father went to the city of Liezhidun to find a seer, looking for clues to rescue the princess.
Little one, you can't play around in the palace! Off with you.
Come in!
Long time no see, Take! So this is the son of Sangruike the Wall Knight? I'm sure you will bring the princess back.
Hello, Take! The new guard at the door probably doesn't know you!
So you're Sangdesi! Hmm.. you're quite handsome!.... Our princess likes Take, you know!.. Oh, and they say Kaisalin of the Dragon Kingdom is a beautiful woman warrior. Hmm.... maybe you two......
You may have Take with you, but unless you give me the Wall Knight's armband, how do I know you're Sangruike's son?
Good lad, you truly are a hero's son. Behind the pillar to the right of the throne, Sangruike left you a key to your house.

The two thousand spies I sent out report: Nadi, the mage-priest of Bangpei three thousand years ago, had her soul sealed by the lord of the Five-Direction Warriors, but lately an ignorant boy named Kawen has used star-demon
sorcery to undo the seal. Having lost her body, Nadi seized the princess and bound her soul to her. Sangdesi, you must help me rescue the princess!
Legend says the moon god Haosiping of the bright moons Nidu and Nilun was born when the moons stood highest.
Yet the distance and power of the two moons are set in the Sign of the Moon. To open the Sign of the Moon you need the pattern magnifier invented by Dr. Maiken.
A worn-out picture of the dragon god.
The Gate of Magic exists to bring back mankind's memory of the spirit force. Here, in the name of Nigula, the father of magic, may magic be reborn....

The way of magic is to command heaven, earth, sun and moon........ to take the spirit of all things as one's own spirit, and the power of spirit as one's own power....... The power of magic is not absolute, but absolutely relative.

The stronger one's spirit force, the stronger one's magic........ This gate only awakens; to rise further, wait for a chance meeting in days to come.\n   Written by Moxi, the 34th of the 13th month, Ya Era 1345
Hmm! You found the Gate of Magic and gained its power? You have learned the basic spell, the art of shaping qi into arrows, but your spirit force is still too weak to cast spells well. Spirit force
is raised in three ways: by finding and eating the 125 Magic Beads that Nigula, the father of magic, refined from his own strength and power; by taking rare medicines; and by lucky chance.

Of the three, the Magic Beads are easiest to get. They once lay on the altar of the temple in the sky. But three thousand years ago Dakelitan, empress of the super-civilized Zhunaer Empire, and Nadi led

the White Rose Legion; their battle at Mount Mata shook the temple and overturned the altar, and the beads scattered over the land. So people can pick them up and grow in magic. That is all. May Nigula be with you.

I am the captain of the Maiya royal guard. I just found the Gate of Magic here and learned magic. Want to travel with me? Why not find the Gate of Magic first, and come back to me once you have learned magic?
Hmm! Your magic has grown. You really want me to come with you? All right! You look noble and sincere enough. I accept. I swear as captain of the Maiya royal guard:

I will travel with the hero Sangdesi and work with him without selfishness. If my heart is not as pure and selfless as the bright moons Nidu and Nilun, may the great sun Ade burn me to death. Sworn, Take.
But Sangdesi, we are both still too weak. I found that this cave has a secret room. Maybe the steel saw I found can open it, and we'll see if there is anything useful inside.
Mount Qichong

Mount Qichong has seven levels inside, each floor a fathom thick, stacked like a tower; it is also called Seven Tower Mountain. Legend says the Lord of Gods appointed the five heavenly gods here and taught the ageless Yueke the way of wisdom.
The first level: thirteen fathoms high
Hello! Did you bring anything to eat? I'd love a bite of my favorite, a veggie ball.
Wow! Thank you so much! From last year to this year I haven't eaten a thing for twenty-five whole months!
The second level: seven fathoms high

This place was once praised by the gods and loved by all. Alas! Where are those days? Where are those days!... The Dragon Finder in the chest may help you. Far in the east, underground, lives a great dragon;
use the Dragon Finder to lure it out, then put it to sleep with the Dragon Lullaby, and you can easily do away with Dageng the fire dragon.
Hello!
The third level: nine fathoms high
2..1193..45...x.265.... Hey! Did you bring a calculator?
Hmm!...Ah! So 48276 is the distance from the planet Maiya to the great sun Ade! I must write this discovery down... Thank you so much for the calculator. To thank you....
I'll give you these four decoders as a keepsake. A decoder can open any electronic lock!
If you meet anyone who has worked out the distance between the two moons Nidu and Nilun, don't forget to come back and tell me.
The Spring of Wisdom is in the city of Limuya. If you go there, be careful: the way is very dangerous.
Mount Qichong summit database ID 1785. See the database for the details below:
Kaluoan I 1967 Fenni 2615 Dakelitan 2831 Xindeli 3698 Hudu 2836 Nadi 2830 Mata 2751 Luokete 5674 Mier 8510 Lunduosi 8731
Kaluoan I 1967 Fenni 2615 Dakelitan 2831 Xindeli 3698 Hudu 2836 Nadi 2830 Mata 2751 Meilani 5674 Mier 8510 Lunduosi 8731
The fourth level: eleven fathoms high
The Coral Bird is out on business.
The fifth level: ten fathoms high
No wonder you could break my attack. Whoever wears the badge of the Moon War God must have an unyielding will and grow stronger with every fight. I hope you find your other companions.
I got the Magic Card last year from Loki in the city of Liezhidun. It can judge the good and bad in people's hearts, and lately it is the pass for getting in and out of Liezhidun.
Come in!
The sixth level: eight fathoms high
You must show the Mirror of Truth to prove your hearts are honest. Only then can I let you into the seventh level to see Beiluo, King of All Birds.
Mount Qichong: eighteen fathoms high

I am Beiluo, the seven-colored bird who came to Hongqi forty thousand years ago with the heavenly folk. In your short lives, everything of you high humans is as brief and fragile as foam. Gede believed that if
human life could go on and on, the peace-loving nature of the high humans would surely create a heaven on earth. So he left a secret art, hoping the destined would learn it and pass it on.
But the first to obtain it, a woman mage-priest, broke the gods' plan for an ideal land, and the gods took the art back. Yet Nadi had already passed it to the seven witch lords who followed her....
They are: the Great Serpent, Jormungandr; the White Wolf, Fenrir; Evil Water, Gealun; Upheaval, Lanen; Despair, Nidhogg; Death, Hel; Wickedness, Loki. Alas! Humans... such selfish, foolish,
conceited creatures, dreaming of having everything. Little do they know that though the gods agreed never again to meddle in the world, they long ago left a hidden move in reserve.
The beastmen's iron works. No one but beastmen may enter! Trespassers die!
I'm a metalsmith from Yatelan. The beastmen caught me and brought me here twenty-five years ago.. you.... do you have the Illusion Glasses, so I can see the world outside?
Thank you! Here is a Silver Key; you can open the secret room here with it. Inside are a precious arrow and a bottle of Silver Solvent. The Silver Solvent is especially precious, for it can melt
anything made of silver. It is a rare medicine. I think it will be useful in your adventures; keep it safe.

If you pass through Yatelan, would you give this Smith's Hammer to the owner of the "First Metal Shop"? The Yatelan Empire is also called the Land of Smiths; its blacksmiths can easily forge any metal thing.
Hello!
Welcome to the City of Gold ---- the Waiyinka Empire
From today the palace holds the Nine-Square Maze contest. Each stage cleared wins a treasure chest; the final winner may visit the mysterious Tomb of Xigula ---- the Golden Tomb.   King Wasika
Congratulations to Sangdesi for solving the Nine-Square Maze!!   King Wasika
Would you like to challenge my Nine-Square Maze? Come and play in the maze behind me!
I'm sure we will meet again!
The Sure-Win Charm is a wonder of the world; I won't just give it to you. You must trade it for the Blood Jade of the Glass Palace.
This is the Sure-Win Charm. It can be used only once; make it count.
Welcome, look around as you like!
Come in! Welcome to the Nine-Square Maze contest.
Welcome to the first level of the Maze! You must first defeat me, then solve my riddle, to pass.
First level, an easy one! What is the total area of the Hongteluo continent, in square km?
Please go on to the next level!
Here is a door made of silver. If you can find a way to open it, you pass. And you get a Pocket Monkey, which opens the gate of Mount Qichong.
Please go on to the next level!
Enter the underground treasure room no one can solve!
Tell me, how high is the moon?
Please go on to the next level!
Enter the underground treasure room no one can solve!
How far does sunlight travel?
Please go on to the next level!
Enter the underground treasure room no one can solve!
In which month each year do the sun and moon rise together?
On which day of the 13th month do the sun and moon rise together?
Please go on to the next level!
Enter the underground treasure room no one can solve!
You must place fifty gold coins in "the Sunlight Wind" as the key.
Please go on to the next level!
Enter the underground treasure room no one can solve!
The spark that overturned the world was the affair of the horn. In what year of the Ya Era did it happen?
Please go on to the next level!
Enter the underground treasure room no one can solve!
The home of Baye, the earth god?
Please go on to the next level!
Enter the underground treasure room no one can solve!
By your reckoning, about how big is the planet Hongqi?
Please go on to the next level!
Enter the underground treasure room no one can solve!
The god of books ---- the Tomb of Xigula
Heaven's Notes, page 304 .... set Hongqi upon the Laji Staff ....
Spirit Pool
Little brother, you're here to dig for gold too! I'm afraid you'll be let down. "City of Gold" only means people here have lots of money, so folks like me come to do a bit of business and earn some.
Arena
Don't miss it! The toughest armor is sold only here.
They say somewhere in the palace a heap of gold left by Xigula is hidden, with a ruby as big as a fist. No one has found them to this day.
You're too old for toys, but you could buy one as a gift. Only nine gold coins each. Want one?
A master knows quality at a glance! The sharpest weapons at the lowest prices; after today, never again. Don't miss your chance!
In a few days it's the day the sun and moon rise together.... you two.... hey! Shouldn't you find a girl to celebrate with!
Today only: get the strongest attack power!
A novel by a famous author, only twenty-two gold coins. Buy one?
Got a girlfriend? Buy her a hairpin! Only eleven gold coins each!
Buy a wine cup and have yourself a drink! Only eighteen gold coins each!
What do you have for me?
Thanks, big spender!
I've been racking my brain for a gift for tomorrow's Couples' Day at mid-month. Hmm! A hairpin.... a pin for hair, two people as close as hair on one head. So romantic, so original!
Your hairpin has set my wife and me at odds. He said three people are as close as hair; she said either I'm cheating or I don't trust her. Sigh!
I don't want to talk to you. Go away!
Don't think I'll talk to you just because you're handsome!
Thank you, handsome!
Maybe this toy will stop my child crying. Sigh! Lately I often hear children's voices from the sky, saying: stars floating in the sky, fell off the slide.. I'm probably just jumpy.
Hello, Sangdesi!
Young man, don't stand there in the way of my drinking!
A drink, a drink! I was just looking for a cup to pour that bottle of Moben's, the best wine in the world, brewed from tata fruit. Thank you so much!
Thank you, good lad!
In the chest is a bottle of aged vinegar, good for beauty. Could you take it to Natasha, the owner of the Sword Lodge? I promised it to her but keep forgetting to send it.
Young man, good people are never lonely!
You want to give me something?
Sangya Village
Wow! Thank you! I love reading! Teacher says the great Xigula loved reading too, and that's how he invented the way to turn water into gold. Did you know he is also called the god of books!
And the book says: on the middle day of each year the sky is half dark and half light, and the sun and the moon are in the sky at once. How wonderful!
Hello, Sangdesi!
I'm Censun. My luck has been terrible lately. The money I just made was all lost again in two days. I've heard about you.. actually I'm a warrior's descendant too, but I can't go with you....

because... because... gambling ruined me. Never mind! In this chest is the badge of the Moon War God. Never mind whose favor it costs me, I'll sell it to you for just two hundred gold coins. All right?
It's in the chest; take it yourself. And since you paid so readily, I'll throw in the pearl necklace in the other chest.
Wow! Wonderful! Thank you so much! What's in that chest is yours. Hey! If you meet the white-haired man, don't say I gave it to you, or I'm done for.
Remember: on the 35th of the 14th month, the moon god's birthday, polish the badge and hold it up to the moon to gain the moon's power.
Crime scene, keep out. Wanted: the suspect Kawen, who fled after killing his parents. For crimes so great he is to be killed on sight, as a warning to all.   King Wasika
A photograph, signed beneath: Kawen.
Welcome to the Land of Hope ---- the Liyinka Empire
People are great because of dreams, and live because of hope. This city has the best chances to help you realize your dreams and reach your hopes.   King Adaer
This is very important to you; please keep it!
The palace grounds: only those with a VIP pass may enter the palace to seek hope.
You want the secret of the Plunge Tunnel?!?.... You must gamble with me for everything you have. Only if you win will I tell you the secret.... But you have only one chance in two hundred of winning.
King Adaer's mouth curled into a sly smile.... Beat the King of the Gambling Land? Ha! Madness.... another fat sheep walking in by itself... The king laughed happily, ha! ha! ha......
Sangdesi and the others dragged their heavy feet, doubting their luck more with every step: could it last?! As the king's cruel laughter rang out, cold sweat and fear gripped every heart.

Duty and mission at last woke their courage. When the heroes' readiness to die rose to their brows, that mighty spirit was enough to chill anyone. Adaer's sly grin vanished; cold sweat ran down his neck.
Notice: the area of the Hongteluo continent
....Oh! I can't believe you won!.... You... you may take the armrest off the throne; it is the Handrail Key that opens the secret of the Plunge Tunnel.... I, I,... boo! hoo! hoo! hoo!
Y-you again? What do you want?!?!?!
Shatan, my love. I hope you remember our vows.   Yalike
Sang'er: three tiger beasts have rushed down Seven Tower Mountain!   The hateful dancer
Old Wu: I know you love the Kabuti blue wine here, but don't forget our redfish appointment.   Old Bei
Farewell, my dear gambler!
Interested in a God Power Pill that adds 10% to your attack? Only 30 gold coins each.
The club's Yinka dance is the most beautiful dance on all of Hongqi. Look: their costumes and moves stand for Hongqi's ideal of the three realms living together in peace.
It's so unfair. Why are those who are weak and don't know violence always bullied? Being human, are we worth less than the brutish, ignorant, stupid monsters of Mount Wuta?
I'm the finest cook in the land and have tasted every delicacy, yet I've never eaten the legendary Kalan shark fin. Wow! They say eating it doubles your life force.
The kitchen is no place for you!
Menluo is a big fool who only likes barley fruit
There's only one iron pot
Kawen was here.. stupid humans
Taluofu is a boring liar
The dragon Dageng harms the world; it must be killed
The dragon is a symbol; it must not be killed
How can we save the country without killing it
Two boring fools
The 23rd of the 13th month, the day the sun and moon meet. Are you lonely?
You want in? Where's your ticket?
Sangdesi! I admire your courage, but if you want to pass the Plunge Tunnel, first you must beat me, Kawen!
Remember me? I am the Left Chancellor who fled the Bangpei Empire. Your meddling did this to me. You are dead!

This is the year 4682 of the Ya Era...... Far, far away, in a universe as deep as the pupil of an eye, hangs a beautiful world like red lips: hidden in the Great Red Galaxy, where high humans, beastmen
and the spirits of nature, three races, live together: the world of Hongqi. The planet is about 1.8 billion years old, a young and newly born world. Yet its science and culture have gone through
three ages, the Guan, Tian and Ya Eras, seventy thousand years in all. Around the year 40,000 of the Guan Era its science led the universe. But in the Battle of Yalemeng nearly eighty percent of its
civilization was destroyed. It was saved only by the heavenly folk who came from the solar system at space-time coordinates 01004. Then came the Tian Era, and after it today's Ya Era. Though at every
change civilization was cruelly ravaged, the worst came after the year 1682 of the Ya Era. What is left is less than one percent of the Guan Era's.

At first Hongqi had only one race, the high humans. After the Battle of Yalemeng, the Yalemeng people and the heavenly folk remained too. Today's peoples come from these three mixing and changing. So today's
high humans are no longer pure, but have magic in their bodies; the beastmen are no longer the brilliant Yalemeng people of old; and the spirits are an entirely new race, with the high humans'

fine mind and wisdom, the Yalemeng people's strength and endurance, and the heavenly folk's magic and grace. The world of Hongqi, made of high humans, beastmen and spirits, is called the Three Realms.

After the Battle of Yalemeng, people honored the heavenly folk who saved Hongqi as gods. The five gods are: Gede, god of heaven; Baye, god of the earth; Saiou, god of the sun; Haosiping, god of the moon; Lida, god of the stars.

All sorts of people come through here. A while ago a white-haired man with one eye bigger than the other came looking for the sound of the magic flute. He didn't find it, and went off hugging a rag doll
just like himself, saying he would go to the sea first and then up to the sky. Hmph! That white-haired freak may look fierce, but actually he... heh!
Wow! Such a beautiful pearl necklace! Shall I trade you the treasure in my chest for it?! A white-haired man with one eye bigger than the other gave it to me to keep. It's his house key.
Save me, someone wants to kill me! He.. he's in the city. I don't know who he is, but he carries a Flying Spear; he's easy to spot.
Hello!
Oh! You killed the Left Chancellor! Ha! Ha! But I, the King of Bangpei, am different. I'll make you suffer!
Welcome to the Liyinka Empire! Have you been to the Crazy Club?!
Shatan, the dancer at the Crazy Club, was killed this morning. They say her killer fled north. Go after him; I'll ask around for more news.

Shatan was from Liezhidun, and they say the news has already reached there. The governor there, Loki, has promised that whoever brings the killer to justice may see the precious oracle, the Heaven's Notes.
Hello!
They say the picture of the dragon god holds the secret of entering the Dragon Kingdom.
In the Bangpei palace there is a room with a flying cloud drawn on the floor. They say long ago it was a transfer station to the land above the clouds. But no one knows where the switch is.
So you are the brave warriors everyone has been talking about! It's wonderful to meet you.
After you saw Shatan, a white-haired man with one eye bigger than the other came looking for her too.
Sigh! God Power Pills are no good.
Who do you think you are? The world doesn't need a know-it-all like you to judge right and wrong. There is no line between right and wrong.
What must go will go; what must come will come. The human world is nothing but a struggle of life, death and power. Heh! heh! heh! All living things just prey on one another.
How many fathoms high is Mount Qichong?
Hello! Would you like to buy a Magic Lens to look down on the land? Big sale today, only 90 gold coins!
This hall was built in memory of the Heaven-Calling Warrior, the War God Warrior and the Ethereal Warrior.
Men die for money, birds die for food.
I've lost all my money. Could you give me a hundred for the road?
Thanks! To repay your kindness, I'll send you to a man named Censun in the Waiyinka Empire. He has a treasure to sell; tell him you're friends of mine and he'll sell it to you cheap!
Thanks! Oh, too bad! If you'd met me sooner... Censun is a good gambling friend of mine; I promise he'd have given you the Moon Badge.
I've lost all my money. Could you give me a hundred for the road?
Sun-Moon Boundary Stone: the planet Maiya has twenty-five months a year, forty-five days a month. It turns forward 584.5 days, then backward 584.5 days. So mid-year the sun and moon rise together.
This boundary is the center of the wonder; here the sun and moon pass in each other's arms.
Three Stone Cave

Sangdesi: I think I've run into trouble.. I left something at the old storage station in Liezhidun.... The code is: the tiger and the mountain at the two ends, the duck, the trouser legs and the iron pot in the middle.
The City of Liezhidun
Thieves have been rampant lately, so the lord of the city orders everyone entering to show a Magic Card.
Welcome to Liezhidun!
Private storage. Owner: Sangruike.
Sangdesi: Give the armband to King Maiya; he has a key to the secret room at home. The Blue Key came from Kawen's house.
Every house here has an electronic lock with its own code. It's the safest!
[Faster than a comet!].... The Photon Transfer Station sends you anywhere you want to go. No more fear of long journeys; the world is only a step away......
The space-time Photon Transfer Station makes you a high human of the new world, "the world in your hand, the ends of the earth at your feet". Its speed rivals light, faster than any super airship.
Chart: the volume of the planet Hongqi
Sangdesi: Knowing how kind and dutiful you were as a child, I knew you would come to find me. But don't worry, all is well so far. The task King Eding III gave me is beginning
to show a lead, but it is not simple. I don't think I can do it alone. On the way you must have met many beastman attacks. The beastmen have always lived in the Wuta mountains, and for thousands

of years never attacked the high humans. Legend says three thousand years ago the Warriors of the Five Directions set a barrier at Mount Wuta that held the beastmen in. Why has the balance of a thousand years broken
now? From what I've learned, someone broke the barrier. A young man named Kawen from Waiyinka has disappeared; he may be the key. I'm tracking him now, and may find something.
With this Rock Knife, I will contact you "among the three stones".\n                     Father, Sangruike
Yes, I'm from the world underground. Hard to believe, isn't it! Just as we find it hard to believe there's a world above. Sigh! Who knows why the same people never visit each other.
They say there's a tunnel straight down below. Maybe once it's found, the worlds above and below can come and go.
Five numbers are hidden in this blueprint. Tell the five numbers to Naya, and he'll build you a bridge across the lava at the lowest price.
Look at the window blueprint as you like.
Hello, I'm Loki, the governor of Liezhidun. Here I'm the boss; bring me any problem and it's settled.
Shatan died after you saw her, so for now you are suspects. I'll give you a chance: within a hundred days, if you can find the killer and bring him to justice,
you may see the precious oracle, the fragment of the Heaven's Notes. It will help you a great deal.

Very good, you have finally done away with Kawen the murderer. You rid the people of a menace, and gave me an answer for the death of the dancer Shatan. The Heaven's Notes is on the table; read it as you like.
Legend says Nadi, who loved roses, once made a most beautiful rose island.

Kalusi was the son of Lida of the heavenly folk and Keleinuosi, king of the high humans, born on the 8th of the 8th month of the year 153 of the Tian Era. In the great flood, within three months Kalusi drank in turn.....
800, 100, 400, 900, 300 and 600 billion tons of sea water, and so drove back the sea that was about to drown the land. After that he was called the god of the sea.
I may be a dancer, but I'm not easy! You know.. Lida, goddess of the stars, is the goddess of us dancers. In the great war, to raise the warriors' spirits, Lida often danced for the soldiers.
You were the last to see Shatan; it's your duty to find the killer.
Thank you for avenging Shatan!
Oh.... three thousand years ago Hongqi's science had gone beyond space and time! If I'm right, the Limuya palace may once have been Kaluosu's laboratory....

From the mirrored positions of the Five Dragon stars it is easy to see the cracks where space and time cross; and those positions face opposite ways, feeding and fighting each other. History can start from there.
The Seven Stars are dim. I think the prophecy of the great seer Zhongluo may come true. The Five-Ring stars are only 10,000, 8,000, 20,000, 700 and 6,000 km from the Death Three distance.

The distance between stars is worked out from the shift in the infrared light a moving body gives off. They say when each star of the Five Rings is thirty thousand km apart, the wheel of fire will fall from the sky.
Legend says the Dragon Kingdom in the east built the Zhunaer period, the most glorious in the history of science of the Greater Maiya world. Perhaps the most advanced weapons can be found there.
Though Zhunaer was destroyed, they say the Zhunaer people have built a new city-state. Whatever happens, the creators of a civilization are more advanced than its learners.
You're not from around here, are you!
Don't listen to that man! Zhunaer's super-science was destroyed three thousand years ago. But they say super-science has reappeared in the city of Limuya! You should go and see.

There's a fire dragon in Wugeer. They say it has raged for over two thousand years. You must kill it and free the people there. The fire dragon that burned the city twenty years ago seems to have been that one;
it nearly destroyed the Bangpei Empire!

Hongqi's history is fifty thousand years long, but by the newest finds the Zhunaer people were writing down their daily lives in all kinds of twisted patterns seventy thousand years ago. This hard script is called Twisty Script.
The old writing you saw on Mount Qichong is, I think, later script, grown from the oracle book that Gede wrote twenty thousand years ago. It seems this script has also appeared on Mount Yabolasi
on a stone tablet. There are only two ways to read it: find the Spring of Wisdom, or ask the linguist Kaluo to translate. But no one knows where he is. I only heard that for a while
he was very keen on sea sports.
<-- Mount Yabolasi area: Warning to travelers: the mountain paths here are tangled and full of wild beasts. For your own safety, do not risk the climb.
I'm Natasha, owner of the Sword Lodge. Welcome. I'm sorry, I'm busy right now; take your time looking at my collection!
You have aged vinegar? Wonderful! Would you give it to me!?
Thank you! To repay your kindness, take the Master's Sword in my chest as a reward. Oh, are you Sangdesi? A few days ago a man named Sangruike came here,
and said if I met anyone else named Sang, I should tell him: the trousers have five legs.
Take your time looking at the swords of the Sword Lodge! But remember the five trouser legs Sangruike spoke of!
You want to learn magic from me? Hmm! Only Sangdesi's earth nature suits my magic. I can teach you, but whether you learn it depends on your effort and your luck.
Learning magic must match one's nature, for all things hold the five directions that feed and fight each other; so do people, and so does magic. Matched well, they strengthen each other;
otherwise they harm each other by fighting. That is what a student of magic must avoid most.

All things have one of five natures: heaven, earth, sun, moon and star. So do the beastmen. So when you attack with magic, use the spell that overcomes the foe's nature, and it will have its greatest effect.
To rise higher, go and explore the legendary holy place of magic, the Altar of the Five Directions. If fate allows, you will surely gain something.

Five Directions: Heaven is thunder, feeds Earth, beats Sun. Earth is soil, feeds Sun, beats Moon. Sun is fire, feeds Moon, beats Star. Moon is water, feeds Star, beats Heaven. Star is wind, feeds Sun, beats Earth.
With the colorless, shapeless, tasteless Spring of Wisdom, you could read this old writing.

The Archmage, her heart full of evil fire, would burn the Three Realms; this is the source of the chaos. Peace will come from the five directions; the five war gods gather in Heart-of-Heaven Cave. Heaven, earth, sun, moon, star: their power shakes the universe.

I may look like a child, but I'm very old. Haven't you heard of a child's face with white hair? Since we've met, take the Youth Water in the chest to the King of Bangpei! He controls the way into the underworld.

Good and evil in this world are illusions, hard to tell apart. Right and wrong differ with each one's background. What is called wrong may be right; what is called right may be wrong. If you go astray, don't panic.
A world of wonders surely has people of wonder. In everything use your heart, go deep, act with care. Above all, persevere.
You want to learn magic? It's not that I won't teach you; my magic suits only those with a water nature, and none of you have it. Sorry! Please go.

Hmm.... Yiouni is just the one to inherit water magic. In truth, though it is called water, its power is not water itself; it borrows water's motion, soft as brocade, hard as mountain rock. Water's power can be light as down

or shake the mountains. Water magic sets off the spirit of nature to reach the godlike state of the Three-Realm God and use the power of the three realms. But reaching the Three-Realm God takes fate and luck.
In three thousand years only the Three-Realm Spirit has learned this art. But five hundred years ago he vanished like vapor. Alas! To learn the Three-Realm God.... alas....
I have held nothing back. Go now!
Sangdesi's father is a Wall Knight?! Then he must be Sangruike. Twenty years ago Bangpei was ruled by the good King Sigao. One day a fire dragon burst out from under the ground; it not only hurt

the people of Bangpei but carried off the prince, who was only one year old. To save the prince, the king chose the twenty finest warriors in the land and formed the Wall Knights, led by himself. They chased the dragon

the way it had come. When they had all gone underground, the king's brother Siting spread word that the king was dead and seized the throne. King Sigao hurried back, but Siting not only shut him out of the city, he even
sent an army of a hundred and twenty thousand against him. Though the twenty Wall Knights stood against hundreds of thousands, in the end they were too few: killed, wounded, scattered. King Sigao too
was never heard from again. One story says he died in the dragon's jaws; another says he was killed saving Queen Ailun. But who knows the truth!
I am Jianuo. I'm no one, just a commoner disgusted with people's greed. I remember I once gave a Demon-Seal Sword to a Wall Knight. I wonder how he is now? Sigh...
This Demon-Seal Sword belongs to Sangruike. You're his son?! After the Battle of the Full Moon he fell underground and met the fire dragon.... I never thought he'd escape. How wonderful!
All these years I've lived on in shame, waiting for this day. I want to see Siting's end with my own eyes. I'll do all I can for what your father asked. But this crippled body cannot
go with you...... Here are three sets of Wall Gold Armor, my own weapon the Yabolasi Sword, and the Mirror of Truth. I give them to you to do heaven's justice.
Do your best, Sangdesi!
Hello, I am Yiouni, the water spirit. Nadi the Archmage has returned and uses the Heaven's Water to strengthen the beastmen; she will bring ruin upon our spirit realm and the human realm.
I will go with you and give what little strength I have. Let us be companions and stand together!
The Bangpei Empire
Where's your Hero Card?
Good day!
Your Majesty!
No one may enter the palace without a Hero Card.
Come in!
Your Majesty!
Maybe you should go to the arena and win some Hero Cards.
Come in!
Your Majesty!
Welcome! Welcome! I am King Siting. Going underground through the secret passage? You may, you may, but....
Heh! Heh! Wonderful! This is just the potion of youth I've dreamed of. The key is in the chest; take it yourself!
The secret room is in the last room. I'm not lying! The Stone Key really is the key to going underground. How to use it is your own problem.
Throwing gold coins here, what a waste!
I am the Left Chancellor. If you give the king a medicine to make him young again, the king will give you the key to the secret door underground.
Hee! Hee! Hee! Hee!.... You have the Stone Key, but there's another secret to the passage. Hee! Hee! Hee!
In the Altar of Heaven a Light Sword is stuck in the ground. Whoever can pull it out takes heaven's mandate and the throne of Bangpei.

So Sangdesi is King Sigao's son. You were a prince all along, and now you have drawn the Light Sword: heaven's mandate is clearly yours. Your Majesty, I hope you will soon seal away Nadi, lady of Mount Wuta,

and restore the glory of the Bangpei Empire. Rest assured, Your Majesty, I will keep who you are secret, so you can move freely. They say Nadi has appeared on Rose Island; Your Majesty may go and rid us of her.
Hello! I am the historian of Bangpei. On the table is the Short History of the Bangpei Empire I am writing.
Short History of the Bangpei Empire: the empire was founded twenty-three thousand years ago by Hongteluo, son of the heavenly folk and the high humans; its lands covered two-thirds of Hongqi.
In the fountain before the palace is a yellow gem called the Moon-in-Water. Legend says placing it in the Spirit Pool calls a spirit. The arena was once the Theater of the Gods.
The fighting stage was once the stage of the national theater, where the king and the people held council......
No idlers may enter the Altar of Heaven!
Come in and try!
Hello, Your Majesty!
For some reason, a while ago someone who should be a high human, yet spoke for the beastmen, came to see the king. And the king actually joined them! Beastmen are brutal and break their word;
dealing with them is asking a tiger for its skin. Sigh! The Battle of Mount Mata happened because people trusted beastmen too much, and the world fell apart!
Our king always likes to keep one more move after the last. It stands for going on without end.
I'd love to try to pull out the Light Sword!
They say there's a Rose Island under the sea that Nadi made with her own hands, an island all of roses.
To show off his might, the king brought in a horde of beastmen and set up the arena, luring people to fight with the promise of free access to the palace. It entertains foreign guests and also
brings in entry fees. Sigh! All the king thinks about all day is this kind of nonsense; people struggle to get by and complain everywhere. It's bad luck for the country.
Sigh! I don't know why you go along with this Hero Card system. For vanity? Or out of real ignorance?!
Hello there!

Legend says the world of Hongqi had five great temples, of heaven, earth, sun, moon and star. But three thousand years ago Dakelitan, empress of Zhunaer, and four warriors, to seal Nadi the Archmage and pen in the beastmen,
turned the world upside down and broke it. Of the five temples, all but the Altar of Heaven in our country vanished in the shifting of the earth.
They say King Sigao's ghost has appeared, and King Siting and the Left Chancellor fled in fright to Wugeer. Now the Bangpei Empire has no ruler.
They say the new king is the son of the former king, Sigao!

Legend says whoever gathers the five temples rules the world. So the king built and built, using old writings and legends as blueprints, trying to raise the five temples again in Bangpei and win the right to rule the world.
The last room seems to be inside the arena. Once you free the Right Chancellor you'll surely know everything.
The Right Chancellor proclaims: (1) Hero Cards are abolished and the beastmen expelled. (2) Whoever can draw the Light Sword, treasure of the realm, shall inherit the throne.
They say our new king is a young and handsome warrior.
A while ago one of the old Wall Knights came home. Sadly, the king betrayed him.

What you don't know is that this King Siting is the younger brother of the former King Sigao. For the throne, Siting heartlessly killed his brother, his brother's wife, and the one-year-old Prince Desi.
About the siege twenty years ago.... after so long, the king shouldn't still hold a grudge.
Twenty years ago Siting plotted with the people of Wugeer and used the fire dragon to burn the city, killing his own brother. An evil man like that will get what he deserves one day.
Whatever you say, the high humans should stand together, not court the beastmen of Mount Wuta.
They say some of the Wall Knights who fought twenty against a hundred thousand in the siege are still alive. A few days ago a knight came to see the old seer Weier; people guess he may be..
Hello! I am the seer Weier. Let me read your fortune.... Ah! There are two kinds of people I can't read: the utterly wicked, and those above all others.... but you seem....
to go beyond both, as if above even them. I truly don't know who could be worse than the worst, or nobler than the noblest. You've really stumped me.

A few days ago a knight named Sangruike did come to see me. He asked where the old king was, and I told him: in the City of the Star River. I don't know the exact place, but my prophecies are never wrong.
You must defeat every beastman in the beast cave to earn a Hero Card.

They say the ignorant boy Kawen used star-demon sorcery to lock the space-time coordinates of Heart-of-Heaven Cave, both to call Nadi back to life and to shut the cave's door, so the ultimate art of the Five-Direction Warriors cannot return.
This is your Hero Card, the sign of your courage. With it you may come and go in the palace.
Hello!
All idlers, leave at once!
Since the king allowed you here, come in.
The jail is gone; this is now the theater's lounge.

I am the Right Chancellor! I opposed the king building the arena and raising taxes, so he locked me up here... and he threw the Black Iron Key away in the Waiyinka Empire. Sigh! He clearly means to keep me here for life.
This is the arena's last room. Going by Siting's way of thinking.. the last room is the room after the last; so the tunnel underground must be in the room after this one.

Twenty-four thousand years before the Ya Era, the year 5 of the Tian Era, Gede of the heavenly folk and four companions helped the high humans drive out the beastman invaders from the planet Yalemeng. When the task was done,

Gede had to go back to his land of the gods, a solar system at the far east of the universe. Against an unknowable future, Gede left the five great arts, Sky Change, Hongqi, War God, Dragon Rise and Ethereal,
with five ways as the keys to open them......
This is a cave of tangled, twisting paths, with many stone rooms, most of them abandoned and marked by burns.
Comrades! The prince has been found; tell my king not to worry.   Ruike
I am Daini, held captive by Nadi. Please save me.
Sang, my son: the nightmare of three thousand years ago ---- Nadi the Archmage has truly been reborn. Quickly, find the legendary Warriors of the Five Directions....
Ignorant fools: stand in my way and die
Hateful Siting, if my son dies.... I will never forgive you
Take care, my king. If you die, I dare not live; and on whom would the people rely? How can the prince be without a father? Take care, my king!   Your servant, Wei....
The keys to the War God art: the dragon's breath, the fish's footstep.
The War God's command calls the Three-Realm Spirit
Evil dragon! Evil dragon, why have you brought me to this.... I, Sigao, have a clear conscience; why am I punished so?
Space Drive No. 1: straight to the Hongteluo continent.
Space Drive No. 2: straight to the Akemu continent.
The underground continent ---- the World of Anda
Wugeer, Land of the Divine Dragon
Did you come from up above? Good luck to you! A while ago a man named Zhou came here, and he wasn't so lucky: on his second day Dageng ate him. Sigh! Not only outsiders; even our own
people are often eaten by the fire dragon. If you're willing, please rid us of it.
The flower gate opens with the Petal Shears, of course! How dumb! You can just buy them.
You are taking on the all-powerful lady of Mount Wuta. I think with the help of the mage Hetu and the guard captain Kaisalin, you'd surely make an invincible team!

Our country is called the Land of the Divine Dragon, and its fame is a burden. The dragon is a real dragon, but no god; it's a stupid, foolish, evil, demonic dragon. Twenty years ago it was used to attack
your world above, and now the beastmen use it to slaughter us high humans at will. Sigh! We want nothing more than to be rid of it!
They say Naya of Xiangbala is working hard to earn money to build, on his own, a church with only five windows.

The records show that our Zhunaer people had writing seventy thousand years ago. Fifty thousand years ago, using the simplest radio waves, they made contact with the heavenly folk in a solar system tens of thousands of light-years away.
So the heavenly folk sent down Dageng the fire dragon, and Hongqi has had fire ever since; only then could people cook their food. So though the dragon is hateful, it is a treasure of human history,
and must be cherished.

They say Yada has locked up the flower fairy in his private garden. The prison is a ring of the purple roses Yada loves most, but the lively fairy can no longer chase butterflies among the flowers. How sad!
Naya of Xiangbala builds bridges that cross any sea of fire. But getting him to build one for you won't be easy!
Human society is often held back by tolerance, compromise and nostalgia, so its flaws go on forever. We can't let the mistake go on. We must slay the dragon!
Your city of Liezhidun surely sells Petal Shears for pruning flowers.
The Divine Dragon's Cave is in a cavern surrounded by mountains. I think no one but the royal family knows where.
They say the mage Hetu, who went to Yisite Island to worship at the Earth Spirit Temple, will soon be back.

Young man, our world has changed color! Twenty years ago it was peaceful here, with flowers everywhere. But now the earth quakes and the mountains shake, and every plant has withered. It seems Nadi is reborn.... but..
but what of the Dakelitan Curse?.. Will Dakelitan, queen of the earth, be reborn again.... Sigh! No.... never again..

The gods said.. when the gods' wrong power comes, heaven and earth will show four signs: the white head without equal, the red shift of death, the child with a devil's heart, the seven dragon stars going out. When all four appear, the world must end.
Now the white-headed demon Kawen has appeared, and two of the seven dragon stars have gone out.... If this goes on, it's too dreadful to think of. Heroes, please stop them!
This is the land of dragons; maybe a jar would hold the dragon's breath. The fish's footstep.... that's a hard one.. As for the root of stone, you could try your luck on Yisite Island.
Don't be silly; you think you can face the fire dragon like this? Wasn't the legendary Phantom Shield of the Five-Direction Warriors lost in the tunnel to the underworld?!

With just a Phantom Shield and some broken armor, how can you kill Dageng? To kill the fire dragon you need a weapon that pierces steel and armor. The royal family has controlled the dragon for generations; they must have a way.
Some say Dageng the fire dragon guards a super armor. Only by getting rid of it can you get that armor.
I am Yilifu, the flower spirit. Yada locked me up here. If you meet him, don't believe a word he says; he's a big liar.

I don't know if you know of the four signs; you must stop that woman quickly. When I came from the sky, the Children's Village in the sky had already been cursed. If the curse isn't deep, there may still be clues

to find, so please hurry.... Also, I heard that the five great arts, Sky Change, Hongqi, War God, Dragon Rise and Ethereal, each have a sacred tool, the Heart, Heaven, God-Call, Dragon Lure and Mute, that helps open them.
So please find them soon, and let the miraculous Five-Direction Warriors be reborn. To thank you for saving me, take this bottle of Crimson Incense. Not even the coolest woman can resist its charm!
Though you are warriors from another land, it is our duty: we can't let you in. But I'll tell you something: the king is anxious to find Maple Down to make his beautiful Zenith Crown.
You found Maple Down! Hmm! The king will be so pleased! Come in!
Come in!
Don't look down on our warriors. Our Captain Kaisalin is a heroine who yields nothing to any man!
Come in; we'll have a match some time!
Come in!
Captain Kaisalin is not only brave but upright. She has been sent to the land of Xiangbala; with luck you may meet her.
Come in!
I am Aier, king of Wugeer. What is it?
Thank you for the Maple Down! With it I can make the Zenith Crown needed to worship the sun god. When it's made, I can give you one.
You scoundrels! Because you're strong, you think you can do whatever you like? Without the dragon, what is the Land of the Divine Dragon? You.. get out!....
This Dragonslayer Orb is the bane of every dragon. What is Dageng to it!
Y..you..you picked up the Dragonslayer Orb.. you..you..you're amazing!
You killed the fire dragon! The dragon is the symbol of our country; what is Wugeer now? Saiou the sun god will never forgive you.

The Kalan fish, also called the big-fin fish, has coarse, tough flesh, but the crest on its head raises life force. A Kalan fish lives over thirty thousand years, and its crest takes ten thousand years to grow,
so it is hard to get, truly a delicacy of the immortals. Together with the redfish, which cures any poison, it is called the Twin Fish of Hongqi.
These keys are no use; they just look nice. You can buy them if you like: 20 gold coins each.
The keys with flowers on top are said to be for the doors of gardens or greenhouses. 20 gold coins each, all of them.
These keys are no use; they just look nice. You can buy them if you like: 20 gold coins each.
Dageng the Divine Dragon
You must face Dageng with a reverent heart. Otherwise, if he gets angry, he may well eat you.
Y..you..you killed Da..Da..Dageng! He.. he.. he... you have committed a monstrous crime!
The Divine Dragon's Chamber
Hello, I am Luoduoshi, servant of the dragon.

Sigh! You are the stupidest people I have ever seen. Tens of thousands of years ago Gede the heaven god came from a distant solar system with Haosiping the moon god, Baye the earth god, Saiou the sun god and Lida the star god. When their task was done,
only Gede went back. The other four stayed and married and had children on Hongqi. Haosiping had a son, Hongteluo, and a daughter, Litan. Grown up, Litan secretly loved Saiou; but Saiou

fell in love with Liya, a woman of the high humans, and had a son with her, Dageng. Jealous and furious, Litan stole Dageng away and with a blood curse turned him into a fire dragon. Heartbroken, Liya

wept for fifty years, and her tears became precious tear pearls. Though tens of thousands of years have passed, the heavenly folk have not died. You will need their power later, yet you have killed their son. Sigh....
I, Luoduoshi the dragon's servant, have grown young again thanks to the Spring of Life. Thank you so much.
This cave is my private property. Give me two hundred gold coins and it's yours.
From now on this cave is yours.
Xiangbala, Land of the Sea of Fire
The young King Lede has suddenly died! They say he was killed for refusing the demands of Nadi, lady of Mount Wuta.
They say whoever can pull out the Light Sword of the Bangpei Empire can be their king. That's easy: just put on the Light Gloves and you can pull it out! But they say not
just anyone can wear them; they work only with the right nature.
Though the Five-Direction Warriors have the powers of the heavenly folk, against Nadi's undying soul they can only treat the symptoms, not the cause. I wonder if the ageless Yueke knows a remedy.

The magic of Wugeer's mage Hetu and the fighting of the woman warrior Kaisalin are strong, but in the end they were a step too slow. The mage is hurrying to Mount Mata, hoping to head off Nadi. Kaisalin was
invited by the lady of the Glass Palace to teach the palace maids to fight.
Legends, shaped by time, may be exaggerated, or may have lost something.
Yada got hold of two pairs of gloves from somewhere that resist every poison and raise your strength. But he has hidden them.
To get to Yisite Island you need a bridge built by Naya. But Naya lives on the shore beyond the cliffs, where ordinary people can't go.
Time wears everything away: some is lost, some ruined, and some, though still here, is nothing like it was.
Have you heard of a lock that opens by a difference in weight? I know Yada has a stone cave with a square hole glowing red. They say putting twenty gold coins in it does something.
Only through Mount Mata can you reach Naya. They say Naya drank from the Spring of Life and cannot die. He has lived for more than three thousand years!

There's a passage that is said to lead to the world under the sea. There the sky is the sea, and the clouds are swimming fish. Stranger still, below the sea is a sea; the sea below the sea leads to the underground sea. Oh! Unbelievable!
Mount Mata is actually a mountain of pure white rock. At its foot is a stone gate, but the paths inside are tangled and very dangerous, hard to get through.
You are not just people, but those who carry out the gods' will. You will live for Hongqi and die for Hongqi.

In the White Rose War three thousand years ago, Meier, the first champion of the king of Zhunaer, beat the Mount Wuta legions again and again until Nadi was enraged. At the Battle of Mount Mata she turned him by magic
into an undying goat, and set the spirits of strange trees to guard him. By the surviving records, Naya also seems to have been a great general in the Zhunaer army.
Greetings, everyone!
Sigh! I think the late King Lede will be buried in Mount Mata, the mountain of white marble, because the man he admired most of all was Xindeli, king of Zhunaer three thousand years ago.

Xindeli not only raised Zhunaer's science and culture to the best on all Hongqi, but built the richest, safest empire in history. But after the affair of Prince Hudu's horn in the Bangpei Empire in the year 1682 of the Ya Era
set off the White Rose War, the nightmare came. In the year 1863 of the Ya Era the war spread over all Hongqi. The Mount Wuta legions led by Nadi and the seven mages
swept all before them everywhere, except in Zhunaer, where they never won a battle. So Nadi, in the name of peace talks, tricked King Xindeli and killed him at Mount Mata.
King Lede often said that after he died he hoped to meet Xindeli where Xindeli's sword was buried. That is why he refused Nadi's demands.

Ah! Two of the four signs have already appeared.. this.... The "wrong power of the gods" means someone using the power the gods gave to harm the high humans' world the gods meant to protect: the misuse of divine power.

Sigh! The Seven Dragon Stars wane day by day, and the Five Heaven Stars have only just begun to shine; I fear help will come too late. If all four signs appear, Hongqi can only perish... Remember, when you find the Pearl Rod, come back quickly.
I know Menggu of Junk City has spent all his time looking for the Pearl Rod.
I see the light of the Five Heaven Stars, and the Seven Dragon Stars flickering with it.

Take, I have waited for you a long time. Your heaven-thunder nature is just right for the magic of us Heaven-Direction Warriors. If fate is kind, you may reach the peak of the Heaven-Direction Warriors and become, of the Five-Direction Warriors,
the Hongqi Warrior, their lord..... Take these two Magic Beads.

Last night I watched the sky and found the Five Stars unusually bright, a sign not seen in three thousand years. They say when the five stars move, divine soldiers come down. By your bearing, you are fit for a great task.
The road ahead is still long; be careful in all things.
Walk the road you must!
We receive no guests during the national mourning!
Mount Mata

Yiouni, long time no see.. you probably don't remember me; I'm Zhuier, the mountain spirit. I've been here over twenty years and seen many strange things. Like nineteen years ago, I saw King Sigao, who could barely

protect himself, charge back into fifty thousand enemies with no thought for his safety, to rescue his wife. Love that deep I have seen only twice in more than three thousand years. The first time was three thousand years ago:
a royal couple, deeply in love, who could not marry for reasons of state, and died together. That happened so suddenly I couldn't save them, but this time I did save King Sigao
and his wife. So they would not be harmed again, I sent them to.. to.. oh dear! How did I forget where I sent them? Anyway, I sent them somewhere very far and very safe.
I came here out of fear of the world's evil wars.... But a few days ago Nadi passed by with a man; luckily I hid fast enough not to be seen. Sigh! Do you know? When
the four signs are complete, if Nadi is allowed to build a tower of the bones of fifty million dead to gather power, then heaven and earth will never see light again.
They say Naya built a church from the blueprint in the oracle, and it is the safest place in the world, because the heavenly folk worked out where on Hongqi the forces of nature gather,
and built that into the design. So once inside the church, nothing outside can harm you. Otherwise human strength is no match for nature. The numbers of those positions seem
to be in that window blueprint.
I am Hetu, mage of Wugeer. This is the sword of the greatest king of all time, King Xindeli: the Hanging Sky Sword. This cave is where he lies. You could say King Lede died for him...
It's all because I was a step too late.... Lede and I were such good friends.... I must avenge him! Let me go with you! And please help me take revenge!.... I know that to reach Mount Wuta you must
cross the Rainbow Bridge, and its entrance is in the sky. If I'm right, it must be behind the temple in the sky. Oh, and this bottle of Dragon's Breath may help Yiouni.
The Goat Cave.... An evil goat within; whoever enters dies.
Thank you for killing the tree spirits and freeing me. But first, find Xindeli's Hanging Sky Sword. Then I'll carry you to Naya.
The door beside you is open; you can go and find Naya.
First a question: the church window blueprint hides the numbers where nature's forces meet. What are they?
Sigh! Another bunch of good-for-nothings. One bridge: let's say forty thousand gold coins.
You could solve such deep mathematics; I truly admire you! All right! I'll give you a bridge as a reward!
The bridge is built; you may go.
I'm busy. Talk to my assistant about whatever it is!
Whatever it is, talk to Naya!
Don't bother people for nothing!
With a Frozen Fire Clip you can freeze the lava of the Red Sea, but it only works if you put it into the fire freezer.
Legend says that taking the five sacred tools into the inner cave of Heaven Star Cave gains the supreme sacred tool.

Whoever reads this: I am Kaluolan the Rising Dragon, lord of the Sun-Direction Warriors of the Five Directions. When my companions had destroyed Nadi's body, penned the beastmen in the Wuta mountains, and won Hongqi three thousand years of peace,

Dakelitan, the Heaven-Calling Warrior of the earth direction, worn out by battle and grieving for her husband, died at last. In our grief we went our separate ways. We left our armor with Meilani and agreed that in any

time or place, with the Heaven-Calling Charm, the Heart Device, the Dragon Lure Orb, the War God's Token or the Mute Bell, we could be called, and we or our heirs would come at once to set things right. After I left the others
I chose to sail alone on the red sea. Life on the voyage was so pleasant that I reached the end of my days without an heir, failing the mandate of a Rising Dragon Warrior. Now

all I can do is leave the Dragonslayer Shield on the green ship, and the Quantum Gun with the Fen family in the city of Limuya, for a destined Sun-Direction Warrior, who I hope will soon become a Rising Dragon Warrior.   Ya Era 1753
Ha! Ha! Ha! That's right, I am Nadi, the Archmage who has bound her soul to Daini, also called the Queen of Mount Wuta. Heh! Heh! Heh! With your little skill, you dare stand against me!
Don't be silly; the world is destined to be mine.. God! I am God! Hmph! You don't know your place. When the four signs are complete, I'll deal with you clowns! Ha! Ha. ha. ha..
Gate of the Red Sea ---- the Red-Shift Death Point
The mistress knew you'd come. Heh! Heh! Well done getting here, but your luck ends now. I am Nidhogg, lord of Despair!
Ya Era 2764, 11th month, 7th day, cloudy... In Rose Village I happened to buy an old book, "Wonders of Sorcery". It has an ancient way of calling up mage-priests. They say mage-priests
were godlike people with supreme magic, but after the White Rose War two thousand years ago the office was abolished, and people slowly lost their magic. I wonder if the method still works.

Ya Era 2765, 17th month, 41st day, rain.. We're four months late on the way back. Last night I dreamed the mage-priests all have undying souls and can come back to life when called. But it costs a life.
Ya Era 2765, 20th month, 1st day, rain.. That engineer Zhou Wei is hateful; he doesn't take me seriously at all. Sigh! The sea lanes here are really like a maze. If.. if only I had magic......

Ya Era 2765, 21st month, 7th day, rain.. Wonderful! With a mage's guidance we were soon out of that Devil's Sea. He said he'll grant me three wishes.... what, that sounds like the first mate screaming....
Ya Era 2763, 25th month, 1st day, clear.. Found a green ship with no one aboard; its goods put in the hold. .............................
Ya Era 2764, 11th month, 6th day, cloudy.. At space-time coordinates 25917 found a small island planted with roses of every color; named it Rose Island. .................
Ya Era 2764, 19th month, 42nd day, cloudy.. Orders received: return home next year on the day the sun and moon meet. All hands overjoyed. ..............................
Ya Era 2765, 13th month, 13th day, cloudy.. The ship strayed into the legendary Devil's Sea, full of reefs, its lanes a riddle. ...........................
Ya Era 2765, 20th month, 3rd day, cloudy.. Nearly seven months now, and the ship is still trapped in the Devil's Sea; the lanes all around are still like fog. ................
The City of Limuya

They say around 2770, Jormungandr, the witch lord of the Great Serpent, sent the witch Lisha, whose stony gaze turned the people of Yisite Island to stone. When she found the last group trying to flee into the castle's
secret cave, Mengda, lord of Yisite Island, blocked the cave's mouth with no thought for himself to save his people, and was turned to stone as well. The furious Lisha gouged out his eyes.
Later Mengda's stone body became the door sealing the secret cave, and his eyes became two gems joined by a red thread.
Hello!
Welcome to the City of Limuya! After Zhunaer, this is the most advanced place in science. After the White Rose War Zhunaer was completely destroyed, but Limuya was lucky enough to

keep part of its civilization. They say at the end of the White Rose War three thousand years ago, Keleisi, Limuya's father of science, invented a device that turns electric power into attack power and magic:
the Power Converter. They say it could raise one's powers a hundredfold, but it was wrecked before it was ever used. What's left of it is still in the city center.

They say there's a tunnel on Yisite Island to the Yatelan Empire beyond the mountains. Hmph! Yatelan's king betrays his people, deals with the Mount Wuta horde, and even gathers sea fungus for the beastmen to eat. Disgraceful!
A brave heart walks with good luck!
A thousand years ago the Fen family was a great house here. Later, they say, Nidhogg the witch lord of Despair hunted them, and they moved away.
They say they changed their name too!
Bring plenty of food to Junk City; you can't eat just anything there!
The darkness goes farther and farther; the sun will return at last!
Kind ladies and gentlemen, could you spare me a hundred gold coins?
Thank you! For your kindness, take this Blade Ring, please!
Kindness is always rewarded!

Thank you for getting rid of the people outside and freeing me! They were Siting, the king who fled Bangpei, and the Left Chancellor. They are in league, trying to seize the Spring of Wisdom. Luckily I found them out,
and quickly locked them outside. But if you hadn't saved me, I'm afraid I couldn't have held out. These treasures should be yours!
Ten thousand sheep cannot trap one fox. So only by growing strong can we save Hongqi!
It has no effect! Throw it away?
Do you really want to quit the game?
Save to which slot (0-10)?
You killed the divine dragon, a monstrous crime; luckily you brought it back to life. Don't make trouble again.
You brought the divine dragon back to life! The dragon is our country's symbol. Thank you so much.
Yisite Island
I'm Gealun, Evil Water! Heh! Yisite is a dead, cursed city. The mistress knew you'd seek the Divine Cave. Forget it!
Hello, I am Yueke. This city is cursed; everyone has become a mindless stone. If I hadn't fled fast, I think more than my two feet would have turned to stone.
I am Yueke. I do not age because I once received Gede's grace. He gave us the Spring of Life, so I have eternal life.

Children are the hope of the future! Don't make enemies of them; they are not born, do not grow, do not die. Listen to them; what is left of them will show you the way! Don't board the drifting star; it has the devil's voice.
Don't board the drifting star! Heh! Heh! That gives the game away.... The devil's voice must of course be joined with the Magic Crystal to release its power and break the curse.
Love is the source of strength; "jealousy" is the cause of ruin. Both are tied to women, for "fragility" is woman's nature.

I am Yueke. Don't bother me; let me pray!... O God! Ten thousand years ago, when the Yalemeng people invaded, you came from a distant solar system... Three thousand years ago, when the world broke and the Archmage spread ruin,
you worked a miracle and sent the five divine warriors to quell the chaos.... Now the source of chaos rises again; grant us another miracle and give heaven and earth peace! O God....
I am Yueke. Of all the passions, only "love" and "jealousy" are famous for bewitching and beguiling. Both carry burning desires; both easily turn into delusions and illusions;
both show easily in what people do. This is the root of the troubles of the world of Hongqi.

I am Yueke. When the five heavenly ones decided never again to meddle in the world of Hongqi, they left five suits of armor with wisdom of their own, which change size and shape to fit whoever wears them.
Yes, ten years ago I sent Sigao and his wife to the Land of Heaven.... All right! Put this Sky Wing on the upside-down slide in the Children's Village, and you can go to the Land of Heaven.
Let's go!!!
To escape Lisha's eyes, our people seal ourselves away. May it be as the ageless Yueke said: the five heavenly warriors will come across space and time, and the world of Hongqi will begin a new age.

The Glass Palace
Our lady is not here; you can't stay?
Glass is clear and beautiful, but it breaks easily. Be careful not to get cut.
The Glass Palace has always kept strictly neutral. So it was three thousand years ago, and so it will stay. There is nothing here for you; go.
A rose has no thorns; its thorns exist only because others intrude. I advise you not to act rashly.
Ah! This fragrance, lovely as a spring of a thousand colors, this bewitching temptation, what shall I do?... All right! I'll let you into the Red Glass Plaza below, but you must keep
your promise never to take or break anything.
Glass is fragile and breaks easily; broken glass easily hurts people. So it is with the human heart; and women are not the only fragile ones!
Hetu, grief cannot comfort the dead. You four, with my sun-fire nature, match the legendary pattern of the Five-Direction Warriors. Let me join the party and follow heaven's will!
This Blood Jade is the blood Dakelitan coughed up when her strength was spent, pressed in ice for three thousand years into hard jade. It is rare and precious. And I have news for Sangdesi,
both happy and sad.. your father Sangruike is recovering from his wounds in the inner room.
Sang.. Sangdesi.. I.. sigh! King Sigao is your real father. I.. should call you... Your Highness. Forgive me for not rising to bow.... I know the room inside hides the Mirror Shield;
that shield is very important to you. You.. you must find the Amethyst Key and open the door sealed by ice that has not melted in ten thousand years.
So Wugeer was once the Zhunaer Empire.
Your Highness should finish your mission quickly, not be swayed by feelings... Here I.. I will be quite safe!
