Junk City
Could you give me something to eat?
The waste of human civilization; if waste can be used, don't waste it. Oh! I love anything made of pearl. Do you have any?
P..the Pearl Rod.. oh! The treasure I've looked for all my life.. how.. how can I repay you?.. Oh! I know! With these Light Gloves, as a small token.
The gloves are a bit old and may be weaker, but they're more than enough to pull out the Light Sword!.... Don't look at me so doubtfully! That's right, I don't want any throne.
When the realm of heaven comes, thrones and power are mere dung! Dear friends, perhaps we will never meet again; may I bless you!
Hello, I'm Rendao Zhigang. Rendao is the family name, Zhigang the given name. If you don't mind the mess, come in and sit!
The beggar you met in Limuya is my father.... I've finally waited for you! The crystal in the chest is the key to the control room of the Power Converter.... Wonderful,
the family mission of a thousand years can at last be done by my hand!
So good to see you!
It stinks here! Wonderful, it smells so good!
Comfy, isn't it?! Stinky enough, isn't it!?
The Yatelan Empire
Golden Feather Hall
Around the year 2765 of the Ya Era, two lines of verse went around: when the two bright moons light up Mengda's eyes, the rest of the stones will rebuild the house of stone.
Luckily the beastmen aren't our enemies, or else.... Sigh! That's only because the king made a deal with them. A king's heart is unfathomable. Not long ago he swore he would march on
Mount Wuta and let the great sun shine on the Yatelan Empire. Yet in a mere five years he forgot his oath, and forgot how Princess Yala was killed by the beastmen!
Sea fungus is the beastmen's favorite food, and our Yatelan waters have the most of it. So Nadi sent her greatest general, Loki the witch lord of Wickedness, to force and bribe our country

into harvesting sea fungus for the beastmen. Who'd have thought the king, who once hated beastmen bitterly, would agree to Loki's demands! Sigh! The king is famous for siding with invaders, and rightly so.

This is an orrery of the Great Red Galaxy. The rainbow-like planet is Hongqi; the pair of yellow gems joined beside it are the two bright moons Nilun and Nidu, which legend says can be seen from the ground.

The young men here have all been called up by the king to Mount Kakalong to harvest the sea fungus the beastmen love. They were told two years and they could come back; now four years have almost passed,
and there's still no sign of them. Sigh!....
You surely know of the Sigaiya continent in the sky! But I bet you didn't know the way there is in our undersea world. But that way is like a riddle: only legends, no answers.
Congratulations on reaching the sky! Have you ever seen the Pearl Rod, strung from tear pearls? They say you can trade it to Menggu for the Light Gloves, and with them pull out the Light Sword
and become king of Bangpei.
The beastmen may be brutal and hateful, but with us women they behave very properly. They say Loki's father was a beastman who fell in love with Loki's mother. Because from childhood
he suffered scorn and strange looks, he came to hate it bitterly, and forbids every kind of feeling between beastmen and high humans.
I hear Bangpei up on the surface has proclaimed that whoever pulls out the Light Sword shall be king. Hmm! The Light Sword is the earth warrior's ultimate weapon!
The king siding with invaders and pressing people into labor is nothing but cowardice and madness. Hmph! Without courage and will, he's at best a beast in noble clothes.
Legend says Golden Feather Hall leads to the Sigaiya flying land, where heaven was worshiped in ancient times. The key is the Power Lock and the Flight Key.
The First Metal Shop
My daddy hasn't been home in so long; Mommy cries every day missing him! Mister, miss, could you please help me find my daddy?
This is the First Metal Shop. Can I help you?
Thank you. This really was my father-in-law's. But my husband was called up by the king to harvest sea fungus almost three years ago.... The shop makes nothing now. We live on
what little savings are left. Sigh!... Oh, my husband Poyi is the finest maker of locks and weapons in the world. This is the Smith's Lock he left before he went.
Hello!
Mount Kakalong -->
Do not disturb the drills!
The king bears the charge of siding with invaders; what is our small sacrifice next to that?
Have we been here almost four years? It doesn't feel that long to me. But for our country, I think we'd go on even for forty.
We come from many different lands, but our goal is the same. When you need us, don't hesitate to tell us.
Death is not frightening; what's frightening are the cares you know and the fears you don't before you die.
I am Poyi the smith. Sigh! For my country I must give up my own comforts and put my heart into its cause. Please keep, for me.. no, for us, the secret of these drills.
Here are three weapons I made specially; I hope they help your plans.
Let us all do our best together!
Hello, I am the king of Yatelan. This is my secret training ground. To destroy the hateful beastmen of Mount Wuta and avenge Princess Yala and the dead of Yatelan, I have borne the charge
of siding with invaders and trained troops here in secret. But most precious are these brave Yatelan warriors, who left their homes to train hard, hoping soon to master the skills to wipe out
the beastmen. Now the training is nearly done; together we can strike straight at Mount Wuta and destroy Nadi and her seven devil mages. When you attack Mount Wuta, be sure to tell us.
In a little while our army will be fully trained. Please wait patiently!
Rose Island
Young man, no outsiders may enter Rose Island. If the witch lord comes back, she won't spare you!
Hmph! Five fools who don't know when they're beaten, opposing me again and again! Heh! heh! heh! With some old armor and old weapons you think you're gods!....
Princess Daini!?
Ah! You.. thank you for saving me!
That has no use here!
Heh! heh! heh! Ha! ha! ha! ha! ha...

To get the Laji Staff you must pass the Magic Crystal's laser barrier. It's a deadly beam; without the Mirror Shield, getting through the first sanctuary is all but impossible.
The Laji Staff is in the second sanctuary. Put the Divine Cave's treasure map on the wall; once the staff fires Hongqi's beam onto it, you can read it.
A miracle three thousand years in coming... I hope you can end the romance between Hongqi and the devil!

The upside-down slide goes up to heaven.
Don't board the drifting star; it has the devil's voice!
Altar of Earth Prayer
Thank you for breaking the time-sealing curse! Looking back on a life where we couldn't control our minds or our actions, it was truly terrible.

The Children's Village was once a small village near Bangpei. After the Battle of Mount Mata, Dakelitan, warrior of the earth god, heartbroken at her husband's death, cast the Dakelitan Curse, and heaven fell and the earth split.
So the Children's Village floated up into the sky. The Dakelitan Curse uses a multiplier to raise the Hongqi Strike a hundredfold before releasing it: a spell of unmatched destruction.
You came from the world below?! Twenty years ago a man and a woman also came from the surface. They say they came from our mother country, Bangpei. They were always Yadeni's honored guests.
Waah! Waah! Waah! I want my mommy! Waah....
Lost and found again; found and lost again. All cause and effect: just go with fate!
The bewildered heart has come back as it was, but what was lost will never return.
We have woken at last from three thousand years of nightmare! Some seem to know nothing of what happened, still like children of three thousand years ago.
Mister, miss! Do you know where my daddy and mommy went?

In the White Rose War three thousand years ago, Nadi killed the grown-ups of the Children's Village who fought to protect their children, then cursed us, planting a devil in the children's hearts and sealing our time,
so that we would never have minds of our own, never grow up, never die. I am the only one who kept my mind. I don't know why I'm not fully under the curse.
I may look like a child, but I've lived three thousand years.... As long as the curse lasts, I won't die or grow up. They say the sage Yueke is the wisest man on this planet; he should
know how to break the seal.... Here, take the Old Ship Key with you!
Thank you for breaking the seal on the Children's Village!
You are King Sigao's child! Oh! This is heaven's will. Yes! Thirty years ago a thick fog brought a couple here: the king and queen of Bangpei who vanished after the siege.

After three thousand unchanging years, seeing descendants of our old country was the greatest joy! We wanted to keep them as honored guests forever, but ten years ago the king's old wound opened and his life hung by a thread. We
had to ask Yueke, who is mad about crystals, to send them to the land without death, the Land of Heaven. Here we live forever because of Nadi's curse; only the Land of Heaven is
truly eternal. With the Rainbow Crystal you can ask him the way up to the Land of Heaven.
I wish Sangdesi luck in finding his parents! And may you live up to the mission on your shoulders.
The Land of Heaven
A place of deep peace: underfoot are endless snow-white clouds; the buildings on the clouds are white halls, solemn but not stiff, splendid but not vulgar.
Welcome to the land of the gods; boundless joy will walk with you!
Here you will find peace, eternal life and contentment!
The mortal world passes in a toss of the head; all one gains is a single white cloud.
Human rage does not bring about the justice of the gods! Meet everything with a calm heart.
To come here from the mortal world without divine power, you must be the heavenly ones of legend. The life or death of Hongqi is your charge to bear!
You.. you are my son.... The traitors have been destroyed... Your mother and I are old. Here our lives never end, but once back in the mortal world, time would wear us down and we would not last.
Besides, after all these years we two have seen through the world.... What Bangpei's people need now is a young, kind, wise new king. That you could come here shows your wisdom.
If you treat the people as you treat me, the country will surely thrive. Besides drawing the Light Sword to rule Bangpei, you five have the mission of saving Hongqi's future. Give it all your heart!
Oh! My son! Thanks to Sangruike for raising you; thanks to the gods for making you so strong; thanks to your four friends for standing by you in hardship. Sangdesi, your real name is Side.
A few days ago bad news came from the Glass Palace: Sangruike has died of his wounds.... Sangruike did our royal house a great kindness.. so I think you need not take back your real name, Side; go on
as Sangdesi in memory of Sangruike.... Are you wondering if Sangruike will go to the Land of Heaven after death? No. Only the living can come to the Land of Heaven. The souls of the dead,
if they can drift to a distant solar system, may be reborn. So... sigh! Let us pray from afar that Sangruike's spirit is reborn!
Congratulations! Sangdesi's life force has grown.
Wow! Wonderful! Yiouni's life force is stronger.
Ha! Ha! Take can take more hits now.
Congratulations! Hetu has become tougher.
Whoo! Ha! Kaisalin's life force has risen.
There are five different windows in the drawing.

Sir! We're working hard on our show; please don't disturb us.

The heart of the heaven stars lies in purity, serenity and stillness, in the ethereal power of doing nothing! The height of doing nothing, the peak of doing. The night star is in the void, in the spirit! Hetu.... now let me teach you the magic of the stars........

Rolling on for all ages, unbroken for ten thousand ages. Hello! I am Jieyushi, the legendary Three-Realm God! Yiouni, water magic once peaked at "Spirit Change"; later, having grasped the secrets of the three realms,
I created the ultimate art, the Three-Realm God. I hope you will carry it further!.........

The sun god's magic flourished in the hands of Guolun of the dragon folk, so sun spells are mostly named after dragons.. Kaisalin.... when the dragon leaps to the sun, the sun will lose its light and the land change color.... the dragon that leaps the sun becomes king.

Take.... for three thousand years only the warriors of heaven have been passed down by true guardians of the realm.. you have truly lived up to heaven's mandate, facing your mission with great boldness and courage. Now let me teach you
Saiou's magic.... the magic of heaven uses the spirit power of all under heaven... the final magic of heaven is only to call upon heaven!

At last you've come, warrior of the earth!.... Ten days later and I might have returned to the origin.... The center of earth magic is Baye, and its end is Baye too. Long ago Baye saved Hongqi with a kind heart,

and so created the life-saving spell, the Heart of Baye. Later heirs built on it the Hongqi Strike, and the Dakelitan Curse, whose attack is supreme. But remember: a person is made human by kindness....

Wind, flowers, snow and moon, yet the clouds and mist will not part! The witch lord lives forever; how can she be made to die.... Magic is only for the balance of the world; "the Heart of Baye" is the life of Hongqi.....
The divine dragon lives again! You are amazing, great heroes!
Legend says the arena of the Bangpei Empire is the way to the underground continent, and the fireball in the mouth of the dragon god picture and the Bone Key are an important key.
The Fire Freezer
I am Li Cheng, physician to the old Bangpei court. Sangdesi, first get the Blood Jade from the outer room, then come see me.

Trade the Blood Jade to the king of Waiyinka for the Sure-Win Charm, then gamble with Adaer of Liyinka to win the secret of the Plunge Tunnel into the undersea continent. Then you can get the Sky Wing,
find the Amethyst Key on the sky continent, and break the four signs of the devil child's heart, and so free the world of Hongqi.. As for.. Sangruike, rest easy, I'll look after him!

The Mirror Shield is the tool for entering the Temple of Aidefu. The Hongqi Star, taken from the Tomb of Xigula in Waiyinka after opening it with the Diamond Cross, is the key to reading the Divine Cave's treasure map.
Everyone's hopes are on you. Keep at it!
